functions.name: sigma_version
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a version string for the Sigma library. Typical usage is to call this at startup or for logging/version display. The contents are read-only. Ownership and lifetime of the returned pointer are not documented and therefore unknown.
requirements: Caller must not modify the returned string (it is const).
Caller should not attempt to free the returned pointer unless explicitly documented elsewhere (ownership/lifetime are unknown).

functions.name: sigma_add
functions.description: Computes and returns the sum of two integers. Intended as a simple addition utility.
requirements: Arguments a and b must be representable as int.
Behavior on integer overflow is unspecified; callers should ensure a + b fits in the int range if overflow is a concern.
